title: A Orchard for the Clock
author: R. M. Okonkwo
blurb: Silas Nakamura, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the ice breaks on the river.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
